turns.question: How big was our customer base in Turkey at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: We had 5 customers in Turkey (TR) signed up by the end of 30 September 2026 (Customers to date, a running total of everyone who had signed up; this is the customer base, not just those with orders). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
